evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable: evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and fresh-within-2h is false.
No realised money-weighted NET P&L by strategy, chain, asset, notional or observation window.
No complete fee ledger covering Solana priority/base fees, refundable versus non-refundable rent/account costs, and EVM gas, builder payments, replacement or reverted-transaction costs.
No expected-versus-realised slippage, price-impact or quote-age distribution.
No attempt-level execution funnel covering signal, quote, simulation, signing, broadcast, inclusion, reconciliation and exit.
No failure taxonomy separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No Solana contemporaneous entry and reverse-exit quote outcomes for Strategy Lab hypotheses.
No EVM ex-post route outcomes or failure-adjusted counterfactual fills.
No common-denomination valuation provenance for cross-chain money weighting.
No out-of-sample parameter-frozen results, uncertainty bounds, drawdown, concentration or regime segmentation.

Before any promotion, provide fresh attempt-level runtime evidence, reconciled cost-complete realised outcomes, chain-separated and common-denomination scorecards, executable exit coverage, failure attribution, and independent forward SHADOW results.

proposals.downside_risk: Reliable historical valuation introduces oracle provenance and timestamp-alignment requirements; chain separation reduces sample sizes.

evidence.detail: The evaluator sums gross profit, loss, fees, slippage and net_profit across all recorded windows without a chain, asset, denomination or notional field.
Promotion eligibility uses the resulting aggregate net profit and profit factor, so incomparable SOL and EVM native-unit amounts could influence one lifecycle decision.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents false promotion or replacement decisions caused by denomination mixing and exposes which chain contributes risk-adjusted net value.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independently closed SHADOW outcomes per strategy per chain across at least three market regimes, with notional, valuation timestamp, fees, slippage, price impact and failures recorded.
proposals.rationale: Money-weighted portfolio economics require a common valuation unit or strictly separated chain scorecards. Solana priority/rent economics and EVM gas/revert economics must not be combined as raw native quantities.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay SHADOW windows separately by chain and in a common timestamped USD denomination, including all costs. Stop if valuation is missing/stale, if native and converted ledgers do not reconcile within a declared tolerance, or if rankings materially change without an explainable denomination effect.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote-only estimates may overstate achievable exits and add Jupiter/RPC load; they remain non-promotional until matched to delayed outcomes.

evidence.detail: Solana observations deliberately set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark outcomes unavailable.
Without outcome_available, Solana signals cannot produce executable quote-simulated net observations.

proposals.expected_effect: Makes Solana hypotheses falsifiable on follower economics while retaining fail-closed sellability, liquidity and simulation protections.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 eligible signals and 30 complete forward outcomes per strategy, spanning at least 14 days, with at least five observations in stressed-liquidity conditions.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader returns are not contemporaneous executable follower edge. A SHADOW adapter should measure both entry and exit economics using current size-specific routes, priority fees, account/rent effects, latency reserve and failure probability.
proposals.shadow_test: For each eligible signal, snapshot a size-specific entry quote and reverse-exit quote, then mark forward returns at fixed horizons. Subtract quoted impact/slippage, priority/base fees, non-refundable account costs and observed failed-attempt costs. Stop the hypothesis if cumulative net is non-positive, executable exit coverage falls below 95%, or quote-to-mark reconciliation is unavailable.

proposals.downside_risk: Counterfactual SHADOW fills require conservative assumptions and may understate edge if inclusion modelling is too pessimistic.

evidence.detail: Outcome availability means an exact quote, simulation and route checks passed; costs use estimated gas, builder payment and slippage reserve.
The scorecard stores quote-simulated net value but has no ex-post execution result or explicit strategy/market versus execution/infrastructure attribution.

proposals.expected_effect: Separates negative market alpha from infrastructure/execution leakage and produces failure-adjusted EVM route economics.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 opportunities and 30 executable counterfactual outcomes per EVM chain, with results segmented by route, notional, congestion regime and failure class.
proposals.rationale: Passed simulations do not measure inclusion failures, reverts, stale-state losses, replacement fees or realised price impact. Durable edge must include the probability-weighted cost of failed attempts.
proposals.shadow_test: Track each simulated opportunity through its validity horizon and compare expected net with an ex-post executable quote and observed chain state. Charge gas for would-revert or submitted-failure analogues where measurable. Classify adverse movement before submission as STRATEGY/MARKET and quote, RPC, nonce, simulation, broadcast or inclusion defects as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop if failure-adjusted cumulative net is non-positive or more than 10% of outcomes remain unclassified.
proposals.strategy: Cross Venue Net Arbitrage and Learned Route Replication

proposals.downside_risk: Longer observation delays useful strategies and may leave sparse-chain hypotheses indefinitely in SHADOW.

evidence.detail: A promotion-candidate decision can follow eight trades, three windows, positive aggregate net and profit factor of at least 1.10.
The executor correctly marks quote simulations as non-promotional, but no realised out-of-sample outcome layer is present here.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces selection bias and promotion of fragile strategies without forcing activity when no positive executable edge exists.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed forward outcomes per strategy-chain pair after parameter freeze, covering at least 30 days and multiple volatility/congestion regimes.
proposals.rationale: Eight observations and aggregate profit factor do not establish durable edge across regimes, sizes or chains. Promotion should require independent forward evidence, uncertainty bounds and failure-adjusted net returns.
proposals.shadow_test: Freeze parameters before a forward holdout. Require positive money-weighted net P&L after every recorded cost, a lower confidence bound above zero, acceptable drawdown and no single trade, asset or regime dominating results. Fail on non-positive holdout net, material train/holdout decay or missing cost/failure attribution.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any current strategy based on architectural safeguards or simulated quote profitability.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime outcomes are unavailable, and quote simulations are explicitly not realised P&L or promotion evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or loosen liquidity, sellability, simulation or edge thresholds to obtain more samples.
rejected_ideas.reason: This could manufacture negative-edge trades and weaken safety; absence of eligible opportunities is not strategy failure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise raw win rate or leader win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores money weighting, tail losses and chain-specific execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Attribute losses to infrastructure or latency without attempt-level telemetry.
rejected_ideas.reason: The supplied evidence contains no fresh executions, latency stages or correlated outcome data.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. Safety separation and positive-edge gates are directionally sound, but profitability cannot be evaluated because fresh runtime forensics are absent. Cross-chain Strategy Lab aggregation can combine incomparable native-unit amounts, Solana SHADOW lacks executable quote/outcome economics, and EVM SHADOW records quote simulations rather than failure-adjusted realised outcomes. These are evidence/accounting limitations, not proof of strategy or market loss. No strategy is canary-ready or live-ready on this evidence.
